import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { EMPTY_STRING } from '@src/constants/common';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/proficiency/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { extractArgs } from '@src/utils/commandParser';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const uid = e.uid as number;
    const args = extractArgs(e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING, /^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?参悟\s*/);

    if (args.length < 2) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(
        '❌ 参数错误\n\n使用方法:\n/参悟 <功法ID|功法名称> <熟练点数|全部>\n\n示例:\n/参悟 123 5   ← 对ID为123的功法使用5点熟练点\n/参悟 烈火剑诀 全部   ← 对「烈火剑诀」投入所有可用熟练点'
      );

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const lastArg = args[args.length - 1];
    const identifier = args.slice(0, args.length - 1).join(' ');

    let points: number | '全部';

    if (lastArg === '全部' || lastArg === '所有') {
      points = '全部';
    } else {
      points = Number(lastArg);

      if (!Number.isFinite(points) || points <= 0) {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText('❌ 参数错误\n\n熟练点数必须是大于0的整数，或使用「全部」表示全部投入');

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }
    }

    const result = await App({ bid, uid, identifier, points, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'OK': {
        const { skillBookName, consumedPoints, oldProficiency, newProficiency, remainingPoints, successCount, failCount, pityTriggered } = result.data;

        md.addText('✅ 参悟完成');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`【${skillBookName}】`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`熟练度: ${oldProficiency}% → ${newProficiency}%`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`成功 ${successCount} 次 / 失败 ${failCount} 次`);
        if (pityTriggered) {
          md.addNewline();
          md.addText('🎯 触发保底，下次必成功');
        }
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`消耗熟练点: ${consumedPoints}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`剩余熟练点: ${remainingPoints}`);
        break;
      }
      case 'NO_SKILL_BOOKS':
      case 'NOT_FOUND':
      case 'INVALID_INPUT':
      case 'MAX_PROFICIENCY':
      case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
        md.addText(`❌ ${result.data.message}`);
        break;
      }
      case 'INSUFFICIENT_POINTS': {
        md.addText(
          `❌ ${result.data.message}\n\n当前持有: ${result.data.currentPoints} 点\n需要: ${result.data.requiredPoints} 点\n\n💡 熟练点可通过比试胜利获取，也可服用明悟丹提升熟练度`
        );
        break;
      }
    }

    if (result.code === 'OK') {
      const { remainingPoints } = result.data;

      if (remainingPoints > 0) {
        void message.send(
          FormatGui({
            isPrivate,
            bid,
            title: '',
            content: md,
            footer: [
              { label: '继续参悟', command: `/参悟 ${identifier} 1` },
              { label: '全部参悟', command: `/参悟 ${identifier} 全部` }
            ]
          })
        );

        return;
      }
    }

    // 熟练点不足时，引导玩家去比试或服用明悟丹
    if (result.code === 'INSUFFICIENT_POINTS') {
      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '',
          content: md,
          footer: [
            { label: '比试获取', command: '/比试' },
            { label: '服用明悟丹', command: '/服用 明悟丹 1' }
          ]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('参悟失败，请稍后再试或联系运营。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});

export default response;
